title: Confine the plain task-tree export/import wrappers to test support so production exposes only the folder and ledger paths
outcome: Confine the plain task-tree export/import wrappers to test support so production exposes only the folder and ledger paths
acceptance: The public production wrappers export_task_tree, export_task_tree_with_notes, export_task_tree_with_options and import_task_tree in src/storage/work/task_sync.rs are removed or moved behind cfg(test), and only tests called them

export_on (used by folder_admission/relations.rs) and the shared import helpers import_task_tree_on and import_task_tree_with_plan_on (used by ledger/operations.rs) keep their behaviour, and supported folder import/export and ledger tests pass unchanged

completion.summary: Landed exact candidate 65151918bdea7b61238822de0181a4a828be9e34, pushed to origin/master and installed from its release build. All six live stores reported ready with matched host path policy. Exact-candidate full gate passed 12/12 stages and 3/3 preflights. Prior installed binary retained as the recorded backup.
